scientific_snapshot_policy: Freeze before external model attempts; do not alter scientific inputs, thresholds, or weighting after observing responses without a new task version.

prompt_only_pilots.reason: This environment exposes no external model evaluation API. Independent numerical estimators and baseline experiments are not substitutes for model attempts.

qualification_rule: At least three of five fresh ModelEvaluate graders must explicitly return FAIL; local scientific controls do not establish this.
platform_structure_validation: Pending external upload; exact expert config and results/run_summary.json paths are checked locally.

data_regeneration.method: Default generator in a clean staged copy reproduces every public data file byte-for-byte
